definitions.explanation: The way colors are arranged or combined. Used to describe the visual effect of colors in food presentation, nature, or artistic works.
Figuratively, the quality of variety or richness that makes something more interesting, vibrant, or appealing.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from the verb ⟦{彩|いろど}る→彩る：12542_irodoru⟧ (to color, to add variety). In cooking and food presentation, {彩|いろど}り is a key concept — Japanese cuisine places great importance on the visual appeal of dishes. Figuratively, it expresses the idea of enriching or enlivening something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {彩|いろど}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧: to add color/variety
- {彩|いろど}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧: rich in color/variety
- {彩|いろど}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よい⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: colorfully presented food
